questions.q: Which two real jaffle_shop seed tables does this chapter's layer need beyond `raw_customers`?
options: `raw_orders` and `raw_payments`
`raw_products` and `raw_inventory`
`raw_employees` and `raw_stores`
`raw_shipments` and `raw_returns`
questions.explain: raw_orders (one row per order) and raw_payments (one row per payment, amount in cents) are the two new real sources.

questions.q: Why does planning the layer before writing SQL matter?
options: It keeps cleanup logic, cross-source joins, and business logic from all getting mixed into one hard-to-debug model
dbt refuses to run a model that wasn't planned in advance
It's required by the dbt_project.yml schema
It has no real benefit, it's just a formality
questions.explain: Skipping the plan tends to produce one giant model mixing staging, join, and business-logic concerns — hard to test and debug.

questions.q: Where does the join to the customers mart belong, and why?
options: In an intermediate model, because a staging model's job is cleaning up exactly one source, not combining business entities
In the staging model, because that's the earliest place in the DAG
Directly in the Power BI report, skipping dbt entirely
It doesn't need to happen anywhere — Finance can join it manually every time
questions.explain: A staging model cleans up one source only; combining it with the customers mart is intermediate-model work by definition.

questions.q: What column does the planned intermediate model join the orders staging model and the customers mart on?
options: `customer_id`
`order_date`
`payment_method`
`status`
questions.explain: customer_id is already present on both the customers mart and the orders staging model from the Beginner project's work.

questions.q: What's the real benefit of keeping `stg_jaffle_shop__orders` free of the customer join?
options: It stays trivially simple and reusable by anything else that only needs clean order rows
It makes the model run faster because joins are always slow
dbt will not compile a staging model that contains a join
It removes the need for a schema.yml file
questions.explain: A staging model kept simple (clean, un-joined order rows) stays reusable by any future model that only needs that, without re-deriving the join logic.
